# PR #3810: Patch: Update Jungle Loser

Closes #3802

Jungle Loser (`classicplus-019-2`) now always attacks a random enemy Unit it may attack at the end of its controller's turn, on both faces. It has no `chance` param, no "N% chance" wording and no rng draw. Replays of shipped versions through `v0.5.12ap` still fold, because the old script is kept.

## What changed

- **Script** (`c019_2_jungle_loser.rs`):
  - `attacks` makes the forced attack whenever an enemy Unit it may attack stands, with no roll and no `param` read. An empty board still attacks nothing (R129).
  - The old roll stays as `attacks_v0_5_12ap` and `script_v0_5_12ap()`, since it drew one `rng.chance` number even at 100%.
- **Kept script** (`history.rs`): one new `KEPT_SCRIPTS` entry, `(c019_2_jungle_loser::ID, "v0.5.12ap", …)`, and `#3802` in the doc list.
- **Card data**:
  - `catalog.json` loses the `params` array and the "{chance}% chance:" wording. `loc` is untouched.
  - `card-text.yaml` has the Chinese text without `有{chance}%的几率：`.
  - `chinese.json` is regenerated from it.
- **Bot Loser tests** no longer set `chance`.
- **Docs**: `spec/08-catalog.md` row 19.2 (including "Tunes: none."), `spec/07-tokens.md`, `BUILD.md` and `docs/radiant-audit.md` are updated.
- **Pending fragment** `jungle-loser-always-attacks.json` has its hand-written `player` note.

## Fixes beyond the plan

- **`chinese.json`:** it is generated from `card-text.yaml` by `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`. The cross test `r1303_…` caught it still holding `{chance}`, so I ran the export and committed the result.
- **`crates/cards/tests/cross/params.rs`:** `r482` used this card's `chance` as its example of a percentage param. It now uses `core-042` (base 50, Radiant 100, step 10, max 100).
- **`crates/shared/data/short-forms.json`:**
  - The web test `textLimit.test.ts` (R1017000) failed because the shorter base text is now 6 lines and fits whole, so its `"base": "clamp"` was no longer allowed.
  - I removed that one entry. The Radiant face is 7 lines and keeps its clamp.
  - The e2e card-face pixel specs are not run here, so CI covers whether this card's base face looks right unclamped.

## Tests

In the card's `mod tests`:
- The removed `r386_…` test only tested the param that no longer exists.
- `a_unit_it_may_attack_gets_the_attack_with_no_roll_drawn` runs on both faces over 12 seeds. It checks one attack is made. It then reruns the same seed under `script_v0_5_12ap` via `crate::under_kept_as` and checks the old script drew exactly one more number. This is the kept-script proof, so there is no separate `r767000_` test.
- `the_card_declares_no_chance_param` checks `card_def(ID).params.is_none()`.

I ran these commands, and all were green:
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check`.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts --no-fail-fast`, which exited 0. `apps/web/src/wire` was clean afterwards.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --parent-bin <a build of main> --claims`, which exited 0. It reports `classicplus-019` as the family that plays differently.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`: 200 passed, 0 failed.
- The harness's web command after `build-wasm.sh`: 420 files and 8122 tests passed.

## Decisions

- **No new ruling.** Issue #1828 changed this card the same way, and the spec rows carry this change. Tests have no `r3802_` prefix, since `spec check` ties R-ids to ruling notes.
- **Removed the param entirely**, rather than keeping 100 as a displayed constant.
- **Kept the rolling script for replays.** Dropping the draw moves the rng cursor, so dropping the old script would break every replay through `v0.5.12ap`.

## For the reviewer

- `jungle(transfer, rolled)` picks `attacks` or `attacks_v0_5_12ap` through the engine's `ForEachCardCards` alias. A plain `Arc<dyn Fn…>` annotation tripped `clippy::type_complexity`.
- `classify` was run on the committed `HEAD`. The last edits (the alias, `chinese.json`, `params.rs`, `short-forms.json`) are uncommitted and do not change the claims.

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43298992995)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Jungle Loser (`classicplus-019-2`) stops rolling a chance. At the end of its controller's turn it always attacks a random enemy Unit it may attack, on both faces. Its `chance` param, the `{chance}%` wording and the rng draw are gone.

Replays of shipped versions up to `v0.5.12ap` must still fold. Today the card draws one rng number even at 100%, so dropping the draw moves the rng cursor. The old script is therefore kept in `KEPT_SCRIPTS`. Acceptance: the card is edited and all tests pass.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic_plus/c019_2_jungle_loser.rs` | change | Header comment, the new no-roll `attacks`, a kept `attacks_v0_5_12ap`, `script_v0_5_12ap()`, tests. |
| `crates/cards/src/history.rs` | change | Import the card's module; add one `KEPT_SCRIPTS` entry; add `#3802` to its doc comment's list of patches that kept a script. |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change | `classicplus-019-2`: delete the `params` array, reword both texts. |
| `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` | change | `zh.base` and `zh.radiant` of `classicplus-019-2`. |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic_plus/c019_5_bot_loser.rs` | change | Delete the two `set_param(s.card_mut(&jungle), "chance", 100);` lines (about lines 282 and 324). |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | Row `19.2`. |
| `spec/07-tokens.md` | change | Row `Jungle Loser` (line 27). |
| `BUILD.md` | change | Row `C+ 19.2` (line 893). |
| `docs/radiant-audit.md` | change | Rows `19` (line 364, only if it quotes the chance) and `19.2` (line 366). |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/jungle-loser-always-attacks.json` | new | Written by `cargo jackioh patches`, then the `player` note by hand. |

**Do not touch:** `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `crates/server`, `apps/web`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, the shipped snapshots in `crates/cards/patches/`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `catalog.json`'s `loc` of this card (frozen data), or the Bot Loser's script.

**Governing text:** spec §8.7 row 19.2, §4.2 and R53 (a forced attack), R129 (no roll on an empty board), R42 and R412 (the kill and Berserk), and R386 (Nerf/Buff tuning, no longer applicable to this card). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3 covers the patch and `KEPT_SCRIPTS`.

No new ruling is needed. Issue #1828 changed this card the same way without one, the spec rows carry the change, and this patch decides no rule the spec leaves open.

## Steps

1. **`c019_2_jungle_loser.rs`, keep the old behaviour.**
   - Rename the current `fn attacks` to `fn attacks_v0_5_12ap`. Give it the doc comment "R767000: through v0.5.12ap one `rng.chance(chance/100)` was drawn each end of turn, even at 100%."
   - Keep the `PERCENT` constant for that function only.
   - Change `fn jungle(transfer: bool) -> Script` to `fn jungle(transfer: bool, rolled: bool) -> Script`. Its `cards:` field becomes `if rolled { Arc::new(attacks_v0_5_12ap) } else { Arc::new(attacks) }`.
   - Both functions are non-capturing, so `Arc::new(attacks)` works as it does today. If the `if` arms have different types, cast each to `Arc<dyn Fn(&mut EffectContext<'_>) -> Vec<String>>`, or bind a `let cards: ...` first.
2. **`c019_2_jungle_loser.rs`, add the new `attacks`.** It repeats the old checks, minus the roll:
   - `live_self`, returning empty when `None`.
   - Return empty unless `me.zone.z() == ZoneName::Field`.
   - Return empty when `random_attack_targets(&*ctx.state, &me, AttackAmong::EnemyUnits)` is empty. This is R129: an empty board draws nothing.
   - Otherwise `vec![me.id]`. There is no `param` read and no `ctx.rng` call.
3. **`c019_2_jungle_loser.rs`, the scripts.**
   - `pub fn script()` returns `base: jungle(false, false)` and `radiant: jungle(true, false)`.
   - Add `pub fn script_v0_5_12ap() -> CardScripts` returning `jungle(false, true)` and `jungle(true, true)`, with a doc comment like the one on `script_v0_5_11` in `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c051_repeater_v3.rs`.
   - Update the file's `//!` header: `end of turn: this attacks a random enemy Unit`, no chance, "no rng is drawn", "through v0.5.12ap a 100% roll was drawn (R386)".
4. **`history.rs`.**
   - Add `c019_2_jungle_loser` to the `use crate::scripts::classic_plus::{…}` list, keeping alphabetical order after `c019_1_top_loser`.
   - Append `(c019_2_jungle_loser::ID, "v0.5.12ap", c019_2_jungle_loser::script_v0_5_12ap),` as the last element of `KEPT_SCRIPTS`, after the `c047_taotie` entry.
   - Add `#3802` to the doc comment's "Kept by …" list.
   - `v0.5.12ap` is the newest entry of `crates/cards/patches/shipped.json`, and the last commit on `main` shipped it.
5. **`catalog.json`, entry `classicplus-019-2`.**
   - Delete the whole `"params": [ … ]` array. Check the neighbouring entries, such as `classicplus-019-1`, for whether an entry without params simply omits the key. The entry also carries `"refs"`, which stays.
   - Base text becomes `Can't attack\nEnd of turn: This attacks a random enemy Unit. If it destroys the enemy Unit across from your Bot Loser, your Bot Loser goes Berserk.`
   - Radiant text becomes `Can't attack\nEnd of turn: This attacks a random enemy Unit. If it destroys the enemy Unit across from your Bot Loser, your Bot Loser gets the kill instead.`
   - Leave `loc` and everything else alone.
6. **`card-text.yaml`, `classicplus-019-2.zh`.** Drop `有{chance}%的几率：` from both `base` and `radiant`, so each reads `回合结束时：此单位随机攻击一个敌方单位。…`.
7. **`c019_5_bot_loser.rs`.** Remove the two `set_param(…"chance", 100)` lines. The `let jungle = …` bindings on the line above them are used only by those calls, so delete the bindings too if clippy warns about an unused variable.
8. **Spec and docs.** Replace each "100% chance" with the unconditional attack in the rows named in the table.
   - `spec/08-catalog.md` row 19.2: both face texts; and the notes: "one `rng.chance`, 100% … still drawn, so a Nerf's 90% reads the same number" becomes "no roll since #3802 (a 100% roll was still drawn through v0.5.12ap)". The final `Tunes: chance 100% ↑ …` becomes `Tunes: none.`
   - `spec/07-tokens.md` line 27: "end of turn: attack a random enemy Unit (a 100% roll through v0.5.12ap, 25% with no Can't attack through v0.4.9)". The Radiant cell becomes "can't attack; always attacks (a 100% roll through v0.5.12ap, 50% through v0.4.9); Bot Loser gets the kill instead".
   - `BUILD.md` line 893: remove "a seeded 100% roll, one roll still drawn (a Nerf tunes it to 90%)", "the chance reads through `param()` (step 10%)" and "and 100%". Say that no roll is drawn and that it always attacks if an enemy Unit it may attack stands (R129).
   - `docs/radiant-audit.md` line 366: same wording in the two text cells. Add "Since #3802 no roll." to the last cell.
9. **Pending fragment.** Run:
   `cargo jackioh patches "Patch: Jungle Loser always attacks" --source "#3802" --notes "C+ #19.2 Jungle Loser's end-of-turn attack is no longer a 100% chance: it always attacks a random enemy Unit; its chance param and its rng draw are removed, the old script is kept for replays through v0.5.12ap."`

All new tests go in the existing `mod tests` of `c019_2_jungle_loser.rs`.

- **Remove** `r386_the_chance_reads_through_param_a_nerf_tunes_it_to_90_and_no_buff_passes_100`. It tests a param that no longer exists.
- **Keep unchanged:** `every_end_of_turn` (both faces), `r129_an_empty_enemy_board_draws_no_roll`, `s4_2_step_2_with_only_a_unit_it_may_not_attack_nothing_is_rolled_or_attacked`, and all the R42, R412, R1081000 and berserk tests.
- **Add** `fn r3802_a_unit_it_may_attack_makes_the_attack_with_no_roll_drawn` in `mod base`, with the same body in `mod radiant`. For each of 12 seeds:
  - Build with `jungle(json!([]), radiant_face, json!({"field":[{"def":FELINORS,"lane":4}]}), Some(&format!("jungle-noroll-{seed}")))`.
  - Record `cursor = s.state().rng_cursor`, then `s.end_turn()`.
  - Assert `attacks_by(&s, &id).len() == 1`.
  - Assert the cursor moved only as far as the forced attack's random target pick. With exactly one target, the cursor should equal the old value. Verify empirically; if the target pick draws, assert instead that the cursor is one less than under `script_v0_5_12ap`.
- **Add** `fn r3802_the_card_declares_no_chance_param` asserting `crate::card_def(ID)` has no param `chance`. Find the right accessor by reading how `can_upgrade_number` or `card_def` is used in `crates/cards/src/lib.rs`. Otherwise assert `crate::can_upgrade_number(&s, &id, "chance")` is false.
- **Add** `fn r767000_the_kept_script_still_rolls` using `script_v0_5_12ap()`:
  - Compare cursors after the end of turn for `script()` and `script_v0_5_12ap()` in the same seeded scenario.
  - If swapping a script into a scenario is awkward, copy the pattern from another card's kept-script test. Run `grep -rn "script_v0_5_1" crates/cards/src/scripts --include=*.rs` for one.
  - `cargo jackioh spec check` ties R-ids cited in crates to ruling notes. Check whether a bare `r3802…` name or `R3802000` in a comment fails it: R3802000 has no note. If so, drop the `r3802_` prefix and use plain names such as `a_unit_it_may_attack_attacks_with_no_roll`, and drop `R3802000` from comments. `r767000_` is an existing ruling, so that name is fine.

- [ ] The end-of-turn attack is unconditional on both faces, with no `chance` param, no rng draw and no "100% chance" wording in the catalog, the zh text, the spec, `BUILD.md` or the audit.
